description: Canonical source of truth for Deja Vu tier, lane, capability, and budget policy per docs/design.md §7. SKILL.md, references/lanes.md, references/snowball-probe.md, and README.md describe this matrix in prose; they must not restate conflicting numbers. Lane `phase` values (`discovery`, `shortlist_enrichment`, `probe`) match the lane envelope in docs/design.md §5.2.

github.question: What repos claim to solve this?

on_unavailable.note: Required at every tier. No fallback source exists; an unsupported github lane cannot claim discovery coverage and is never recorded as an empty success (docs/design.md §2.3). Because github is required at every tier, this status triggers `stopping_rules.required_human_decision`, halting the hunt for human handoff. (`blocked` is a hunt-level state reserved for an expired probe lease per docs/design.md §7; it is not a lane status and does not apply here.)
Registry coverage becomes `skipped`; hunt may proceed on remaining required lanes but must record the gap in Judge/Record per docs/design.md §2.3 (skipped never counts as an empty success).

grep.question: Does anyone actually write this pattern (grep.app over ~1M public repos)?

on_unavailable.note: sweep.py backs off gracefully on HTTP 429 per references/lanes.md; partial results still count but the lane status is `degraded`, not `succeeded`.

Explicit, documented fallback: rerun sweep with --no-scorecard. Satisfies the coverage contract for Quick tier by design; for Standard/Full it produces a `skipped` lane and health signal must fall back to references/provenance data at Judge time.

on_unavailable.note: Documented fallback from references/lanes.md: never hard-fail this lane for a missing optional dependency; degrade to plain WebSearch instead. Required at Full tier (tiers.full.required_lanes) for the winning candidate's freshness signal; optional at Standard. If web_search is also unavailable, lane_status escalates to `unsupported`; because the lane is required at Full, that unsupported status triggers `stopping_rules.required_human_decision` like any other unsupported required lane.

Optional discovery lane; absence narrows discovery coverage but never blocks a hunt on its own.

Available at every tier via that tier's `concept_optional_lanes`; used in place of the code-discovery optional lanes (curation, skills_ecosystem) only when the hunt has no code to sweep, per references/lanes.md "Concept hunts" and this matrix's top-level `concept_hunt_policy`.

provenance.question: Who maintains this, and how established are they (tenure, footprint, org backing)?

on_unavailable.note: Required at Full tier only, for every shortlisted maintainer (tiers.full.evidence_obligations). scripts/provenance.py is no-throw by design: a fetch failure or missing profile never hard-fails the lane, it degrades that maintainer's signal to `unknown-experimental` instead. Lane status is therefore always `degraded` under partial or total capability loss, never `unsupported` or `failed`, so this required lane never triggers `stopping_rules.required_human_decision` on its own.

hands_on_probe.question: Does the artifact actually do what its README claims?
hands_on_probe.adapter: isolated shallow clone, install, smoke-test, and load-bearing source read, no access to secrets/credentials/the working repo

on_unavailable.fallback: architecture_qa (DeepWiki) as a documented-but-weaker substitute; never a verdict on its own
on_unavailable.note: Required at Full tier only, with no exceptions per references/snowball-probe.md. A Full-tier hunt with sandbox_exec unsupported cannot reach a verified-fit stopping rule; it must stop on `required_human_decision` and record the missing capability.

concept_hunt_policy.applies_when: The hunt has no code to sweep (design-pattern, architecture, or standards questions per references/lanes.md "Concept hunts").
concept_hunt_policy.note: Concept-hunt lanes run the same loop as code-discovery hunts (framing, blind parallel lanes, snowball, judge, gate) and are available at every tier through that tier's `concept_optional_lanes`, substituting for whichever of `curation` / `skills_ecosystem` the tier's own `optional_lanes` would otherwise offer. `scripts/sweep.py` still runs once even on a pure concept hunt; an empty result there is expected, not a failed sweep.

evidence_obligations: Every candidate carries name, url, source_lane, and license from the required lanes.
No shortlist-enrichment or probe evidence is owed at this tier.

snowball.note: 1 hop, backward or forward, whichever the strongest hit's README suggests.

evidence_obligations: Every candidate carries name, url, source_lane, license, stars, last_push, and scorecard (or an explicit skipped/degraded scorecard state) from the required lanes.
The top candidate carries a recorded license bucket (including AGPL/SSPL/no-LICENSE flags) before Judge.
The single snowball hop is recorded with its direction (backward or forward) and the observation it produced.

snowball.note: 2-3 hops each direction, until hits stop turning up anything not already in the candidate list.

evidence_obligations: The top 1-2 shortlisted candidates each carry a sandbox install/smoke-test receipt and a load-bearing source read before Judge.
python3 scripts/provenance.py --owner <login> is recorded for every shortlisted maintainer.
Freshness signal (last30days or WebSearch fallback) is recorded for the winning candidate.
full.invocation: python3 scripts/sweep.py --query "<keywords>" --lanes github,registry,grep,scorecard --limit 10, then python3 scripts/provenance.py --owner <login1> --owner <login2> on every shortlisted maintainer

stopping_rules.sufficient_verified_fit: A candidate has been evaluated to the tier's evidence obligations and meets the pre-registered exclusion criteria and rubric threshold. Stop sweeping further lanes.
stopping_rules.exhausted_bounded_coverage: Every required lane for the tier has reported a terminal status (succeeded, degraded, failed, skipped, or unsupported) and every optional lane has been attempted or explicitly declined. No further coverage exists within the tier's lane set.
stopping_rules.budget_exhaustion_with_uncertainty: A budget ceiling (seconds, external_requests, tokens, probes, or receipt_bytes) is reached before sufficient fit is established. Stop immediately and record the residual uncertainty explicitly; never silently extend the budget.
stopping_rules.required_human_decision: The evidence trends toward a BUILD verdict, a required capability is unsupported at a tier where it is required, or authority for a non-trivial reuse route is needed. Stop automated execution and hand off to the human gate (SKILL.md Stage 7).
